property_summary: After any successful withdrawAll call by an address that had positive credit, the contract's internal reentrancy lock is cleared so the same address can later call withdrawAll again (i.e., withdrawAll remains callable again); the mutant that omits releasing the lock breaks this by permanently locking out subsequent withdrawAll calls.
change_summary: Remove the lock release at the end of the modifier so the lock remains set after function execution, potentially preventing future withdrawAll calls and changing observable state behavior.
